notes_for_editor: Two sources. NHLR is the only source for the 1936 build date, the 1960 end of use and the 1978 purchase and donation; FFLOS only confirms standing. Unresolved lead, not used: a Facebook group post, seen only as a search snippet and not readable, says a 90-foot first fire tower stood on Military Hill in 1927. It conflicts with the 1936 build date in NHLR, so an editor may want to check it. Also not used: Town of Phelps Resolution No 2016-8 (cdn.townweb.com PDF) mentions the tower was constructed in '193' but the PDF text did not extract. The NHLR height wording is ambiguous (120 ft 'including' a 10-ft cabin versus 132 ft to the roof peak), so height_m is left out. No source gives current access, climbing or rental status; the NHLR access and staffing fields are blank, so the brief's access 'unknown' stands and no access key is recorded. Brief record checked: name, county, registration and 1936 build agree with NHLR; no corrections. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story now says the Register's height figure is 120 ft including the cab and a total of 132 ft to the roof peak, not an either/or; it also states the purchase, which the Register implies ('Following purchase'),and drops the editorial advice's footnote. The NHLR visit report (2 Sept 2023) describes poor condition (cab 'will need replacement', glass not intact) and an attached FM transmitter; its access, signage and staffing fields are blank. No photos added.
